tests_notes: Plain fields, separator, quote doubling, line breaks, custom separator and quote, empty input; workload: one 80000-field export line.

A.rationale: The original scans each field up to three times with separate substring checks. A compiled character class finds any special character in a single pass, so plain fields are rejected with one call.

B.rationale: Feeding str.join a generator avoids building the intermediate list of quoted fields, which saves an allocation the size of the input.

C.rationale: Conservative micro-optimization: an f-string builds the quoted field in one formatting step instead of two concatenations that each create a temporary string.

notes: An honest no-win story: the original is already a single list comprehension. The regex call costs more than three substring checks, str.join turns a generator into a list anyway, and the f-string is within noise.
